study.notes: STUDY: STOP (Semaglutide Treatment On coronary Progression), single centre randomised double blind placebo controlled trial (Lundquist Institute, Torrance) of once weekly semaglutide 1.0 mg (dose_mg 1) vs placebo for 12 months in type 2 diabetes with HbA1c 7 percent or more; 140 randomised, this secondary analysis includes 114 with paired cardiac CT (59 semaglutide, 55 placebo), analysed as randomised; Table 3 gives the treatment group coefficient for the change in ALT and AST over 12 months with standard errors from univariable and multivariable regression (route se_reported, MD U/L; the univariable coefficient is entered, the adjusted one in the notes); liver fat by CT attenuation (Hounsfield units, Table 2) is not an inventory measure; secondary outcomes of the trial (prespecified FALSE); body weight change not printed, pct_weight_change empty; Table 1 baselines for hsCRP (medians), lipids and HbA1c but no ALT or AST baseline; supported in part by a Novo Nordisk investigator sponsored studies grant (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 3: change in ALT over 12 months, treatment group coefficient (univariable) minus 2.60, SE 1.91, p 0.176; multivariable (age, sex, BMI, hypertension, hyperlipidaemia, past smoking, baseline ALT) minus 3.95, SE 1.77, p 0.028; no baseline ALT printed
Table 3: change in AST over 12 months, treatment group coefficient (univariable) minus 0.70, SE 1.89, p 0.712; multivariable minus 1.42, SE 1.76, p 0.422; no baseline AST printed

json.design: single centre randomised double blind placebo controlled trial, semaglutide 1.0 mg weekly vs placebo, type 2 diabetes, 140 randomised, 114 in this cardiac CT secondary analysis, 12 months
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); two inventory markers (ALT, AST) as regression treatment coefficients with standard errors; liver fat by CT attenuation is outside the inventory
other_markers: liver fat attenuation by non contrast cardiac CT (Hounsfield units; adjusted difference 4.66 HU, SE 1.43, favouring semaglutide)
hsCRP, lipids and HbA1c at baseline only (Table 1)

rob.justification: randomised double blind placebo controlled trial (D1, D2 low); 114 of 140 randomised with paired scans, baseline BMI differed between the analysed arms (D3 some concerns); laboratory transaminases (D4 low); secondary outcome analysis without a stated analysis plan for the transaminases (D5 some concerns)

doubts: no ALT or AST baseline in this report, so the rows carry no denominator
